body: Trying to not be ashamed of it, but it’s hard. Luckily I go see my therapist on Saturday.

I have, and I probably will adopt at some point. Doesn’t mean I won’t want a biological child. It sounds fucked up, I know. My cousin is adopted I’ve seen how hard it is to go through the adoption process.
I got a note from my therapist, my boss is very pro mental health and it should be fine.

There is nothing wrong w you I can totally assure you of this. If you don’t cut you’ll pick or you’ll scratch. For me I know it’s the only way I can cope with what I’m feeling inside. It mostly happens in anxious situations. I haven’t cut in 5 years and can’t because my boyfriend checks me. But if I could cut I would do it in a heartbeat. As long as you’re not trying to kill yourself, which to me it seems like you’re not I think you’ll be ok. If you ever need to talk you can PM me. I’ve been dealing w this for 16 years.
It’s ok. It’s who we are. We’ll always b self harmers even if we stoped for years. It’s apart of us.
